name: LegalWeb Cloud
author: legalweb.io

sections.description:
LegalWeb Cloud is a fully featured Consent Management Platform (CMP) that integrates seamlessly with your WordPress site.
It connects to the legalweb.io cloud service to automatically deliver your cookie popup, legal texts, terms and conditions, imprint, and privacy policy — all created and maintained by legal experts.

ALL-IN-ONE SOLUTION

As a LegalWeb Cloud user, you only need to:

  • Select the services you use
  • Fill out a few required fields

LegalWeb Cloud and the connected cloud service take care of the rest:

  • Creation of the cookie popup and cookie notice
  • Management of consent (opt-in and opt-out)
  • Control of third-party services and embeddings
  • Automatic generation of privacy policies and imprint
  • Full support for the WP Consent API
  • Integration with Google Consent Mode
  • Certified Google CMP Partner
  • IAB TCF Framework certified

Legal Compliance

Our top priority is full compliance with the GDPR/DSGVO and the latest decisions of courts and data protection authorities.
We do not offer options that are legally questionable or risky.

Created by Lawyers

All legal texts are written and maintained by the law firm Marketingrecht.eu, specialized in IT, internet, and data protection law.

Professionally Translated

All translations are performed by sworn and certified interpreters.
Officially certified by WPML. Also compatible with Polylang and WPGlobus.

Features

  • Optimized for Germany and Austria
  • Usable in all EU and third countries
  • Compatible with Google Consent Mode and the IAB TCF Framework
  • Accessible according to WCAG 2.1 AA
  • Multiple display types for the popup (popup, sidebar, bottom bar, minimalist centered popup)
  • Flexible trigger options (on load, timeout, scroll, custom event, manual)
  • Custom colors, CSS, and logo
  • Client-side JavaScript API compatible with WP Consent API

Imprint

  • Automatic generation
  • Integration via page selection or shortcode

Cookie Popup / Notice / Privacy Info

  • Consent (opt-in) and opt-out management
  • Configurable consent validity and renewal time
  • Correct grouping of services
  • Display of all required legal information
  • No dark patterns or misleading consent methods

Privacy Policy

  • Automatic generation based on your configuration
  • Integration via page selection or shortcode

Support and FAQ

We are here for you.

  • Free webinars (see our schedule)
  • Support available at https://legalweb.io/support/

Team

Our team consists of legal experts, developers, and marketing specialists working together for your compliance.

Important note:
This plugin supports you in fulfilling GDPR/DSGVO requirements.
Proper configuration by the website administrator is required to achieve compliance.
Complete legal conformity cannot be guaranteed solely through the use of this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress plugin installer or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Connect your website to your legal web account.
  4. Configure your settings at the legalweb dashboard and load the settings.
